highlights.title: Devas & Planetars
highlights.summary: Rebalanced 3e-grounded Devas (3 turns) and Planetars (2 turns) without permanent Haste, plus a 1 Deva + 1 Planetar party cap.
bullets: Planetars have 18 HD / 152 HP (no permanent Haste); Devas have 14 HD / 136 HP; you control their spellbooks.
Casting time 9, range 30 ft., BOTH gender so Death Spell ignores death-magic-immune celestials.
Cap allows up to one Deva/Fallen Deva and one Planetar/Dark Planetar simultaneously.
openQuestions: Are the 2–3 turn durations and Planetar stats without permanent Haste strong enough for ToB fights?
Should 1 Deva + 1 Planetar remain allowed together, or should the cap be 1 celestial total?

highlights.title: Improved Haste & Attack Cap
highlights.summary: Reworked from free single-target 2x APR (10 APR) into a 15-ft. party combat buff (+1 non-stacking APR, +2 THAC0/AC/Breath).
bullets: Lasts 1 turn (cast time 6), grants +6 movement and Slow immunity, and coexists with Haste / RWotF under the 1-extra-APR cap (EEex).
Haste and Slow cancel each other cleanly across spells and items.
openQuestions: Keep tuning this party-buff version slightly upward, or let Improved Haste unlock a higher APR ceiling (e.g. 6–7 APR with EEex) instead of auto-doubling?

highlights.title: Dispelling Screen & Pierce Magic
highlights.summary: Dispelling Screen replaces Spell Immunity with a 15-ft. party shield blocking one Breach or Dispel/Remove Magic.
bullets: Lasts 5 turns; Spell Immunity sub-spells (SPWI590–597) redirect here so existing AI scripts cast it automatically.
Pierce Magic halves target Magic Resistance (min 10%, max 40% for 5 rounds, EEex); Lower Resistance removes 30% + 1%/level.
openQuestions: Does Dispelling Screen need a short ~1s grace window after popping to absorb double-dispel sequencers?
How should Breach and dispels interact with Entropy Shield once AI support lands?

highlights.title: Typed Bonuses & Transformations
highlights.summary: Six bonus types (Morale, Favor, Luck, Dodge, Deflection, Curse) and exclusive Transformations replace blind buff stacking.
bullets: Strongest bonus and penalty per stat and type apply; weaker buffs stay active underneath and resume if needed.
Strength-granting spells set a Strength floor (EEex) instead of overwriting higher gear Strength.
openQuestions: Does typed non-stacking make pre-buffing cleaner, or is any specific combination missed?

highlights.title: Wake on Damage, Saves & Clones
highlights.summary: Sleeping/unconscious foes wake on hit, major AoEs roll Save vs. Breath and bypass Mirror Image, and clones lose item exploits.
bullets: Wake on damage applies across Sleep, Color Spray, Command, Greater Command, Stinking Cloud, and Hopelessness.
Skull Trap caps at 12d6; Simulacrum keeps class/kit innates & level-scaled HLAs (EEex) without quick-slot abuse.
Polymorph Self and Shapechange deliver 7 rebuilt forms each with honest stats.

highlights.title: Faster Divine Casting & 6 New Spells
highlights.summary: Streamlined casting times and real die+flat Cure/Cause scaling, enemy-only Silence, plus six new Wizard & Divine spells.
bullets: Cure/Cause Wounds scale from 1d8+5 (CT 4) up to 4d8+12 (CT 7) with undead reciprocity; Heal drops to CT 6.
New spells: Faerie Fire (L1), Mass Regenerate (L5), Icelance & Conjure Air Elemental (Druid), Protection from Cold (L3) & Acid (L4).

systemRules.title: AoE Damage Bypasses Mirror Image
systemRules.summary: Area-of-effect spell and item damage (Fireball, Skull Trap, Horrid Wilting, Breath weapons, Traps, etc.) ignores Mirror Image decoys while single-target rays still strip images.

systemRules.title: Dispel Destroys Created Weapons & Nishruu/Hakeashar
systemRules.summary: Dispel Magic, Remove Magic, Inquisitor Dispel, and Magic-Eating dispels now strip created spell weapons (Flame Blade, Phantom Blade, Minute Meteors, etc.) and destroy summoned Nishruu/Hakeashar.

systemRules.title: Universal Utility Schools & Specialist Access
systemRules.summary: Find Familiar, Minor Sequencer, Contingency, Spell Sequencer, Spell Trigger, and Chain Contingency belong to the Universal school with specialist exclusions cleared on spells and scrolls. Cloud spells move to Conjuration; Power Word: Sleep moves to Enchantment.

systemRules.title: Web, Grease, Entangle & Stinking Cloud Immunities
systemRules.summary: Incorporeal spirits, dragons, true beholders, mephits, ethereal/huge threats follow clearer terrain and cloud immunities; undead, constructs, oozes, and poison-immune creatures ignore Stinking Cloud.

systemRules.title: Druid Sphere & Three New Druid Spells
systemRules.summary: Barkskin, Shillelagh, Flame Blade, Animal Summoning I–III, and Conjure Animals are restricted to Druids and Rangers; Faerie Fire (L1), Icelance (L3), and Conjure Air Elemental (L6) expand the druid repertoire.
